title: checkride configuration
description: Schema for checkride.config.json — add it only to deviate from the zero-config defaults.

$schema.description: URL of this JSON Schema, for editor validation and autocompletion.

extends.description: Preset(s) to inherit — a file path (./base.json) or package specifier (@acme/preset), or an array of them. Bases merge left-to-right and the local config wins over all; objects deep-merge, arrays and scalars replace (arrays are not concatenated).

timeout.description: Default per-check timeout in seconds. Unset, checks fall back to the built-in 600s cap; 0 here or on a check disables the cap.

changedBase.description: The git ref --changed measures from, and {base} in changedArgs expands to, when neither --base nor CHECKRIDE_BASE names one. Unset, it's origin/main when that resolves, else HEAD with a warning. A ref named here that doesn't resolve to a commit exits 2.

requirePins.description: When true, a tool that resolves from PATH, with no pin declaring its version, fails its check instead of running. Default false.

unclaimed.description: Settings for the unclaimed check, which runs once targets are declared and fails when a toolchain marker (package.json, go.mod, Cargo.toml, pyproject.toml, a .tf file) sits outside every target of its language.

ignore.description: Globs, relative to the repo root, for marker paths the unclaimed check never reports; a glob that matches a directory leaves out every marker under it.

targets.description: Named targets, each a language pack checking one directory. Declaring any switches the repo to multi-target mode, where a target-scope slot runs once per target as <target>:<slot>, and a top-level checks entry for one may set only optIn, timeout, order and note (pick its tool under packs or the target's own checks). A preset that extends names, and a defaults file, can't declare targets.

packs.description: Slot config for every target of a pack, keyed by the pack's name. A target's own checks beat it, and it beats the top-level checks.

gate.description: What the agent stop-gate runs, when the full check is too slow to pay for on every turn. The gate then reports the profile in its verdict, so a narrowed green is never mistaken for a full one — keep the full check binding somewhere else (a commit hook, CI).

only.description: Run only these checks in the gate, each named as --only takes them: a slot, a custom check, a target, or <target>:<slot>. A name no check answers to stops the gate with exit 2.

skip.description: Run everything but these checks in the gate, named as gate.only takes them.

changed.description: Affected-only mode for the gate, as --changed.

preflight.description: Repo-relative path to a script the generated stop-hook gate runs before checkride — the one supported seam for wrapping the gate, and the only one that survives a refresh (agent-setup rewrites the generated script and re-points the harness config, but re-reads this file). Exit 0 runs the gate; exit 2 blocks the turn; any other exit stands the gate down. Either non-zero branch uses the script's stdout as the message and never runs checkride.

checks.description: Per-slot configuration. A key that matches a catalogue slot (types, format, lint, struct, dead, dupes, health, test, docs, links, spell, prose, mutation, security, build, publint, attw, pack, smoke, snippets, unclaimed) configures that slot; any other key is a custom check that runs alongside the catalogue. Naming an opt-in slot (format, dupes, health, prose, mutation, security, build, publint, attw, pack, smoke, snippets) here also opts it into the default run — set optIn:true on the entry to configure it without opting in (run it only with --all/--include).

packName.description: A language pack: ts checks TypeScript code from its root, and bash checks a list of shell scripts under its root.

targetName.description: A target's name: a lowercase letter, then up to 31 lowercase letters, digits and hyphens. Slot names, schema and unclaimed included, are reserved, and so is every custom check's name, so a selection token means one thing.

root.description: The target's directory, relative to the repo root (. for the root itself). It must exist, can't be absolute or pass through .., and two targets of one pack can't share or nest their roots.

include.description: Globs, relative to root, for the files a file-list pack (bash) checks: **, *, ? and {a,b}. Omitted, bash checks every .sh and .bash file and each extensionless file with a shell shebang. A pack that checks its root rejects it.

exclude.description: Globs, relative to root, for files a file-list pack (bash) leaves out; a glob that matches a directory leaves out everything under it. A pack that checks its root rejects it.

checks.description: This target's own slot config and custom checks, beating packs and the top-level checks. An adapter named here must belong to the target's pack, and repo-scope slots (struct, docs, links, spell, prose) belong in the top-level checks.

packConfig.description: Slot config for every target of one pack.

checks.description: Slot config and custom checks for every target of this pack. An adapter named here must belong to the pack, and repo-scope slots belong in the top-level checks.

note.description: Internal documentation for whoever reads this config next. Never rendered in the CLI output or written to .check/summary.json — use description for the user-facing text a run prints beside the check.

slotConfig.description: How to fill a slot: an adapter name, false to disable it, an adapter with overrides, or a custom check.

oneOf.description: Adapter name that fills this slot, beating detection.

slotTuning.description: Keep the tool detection picks and tune only how the slot runs. Once targets are declared, this and false are the only forms a top-level entry for a target-scope slot takes; pick its tool under packs or a target's own checks.

optIn.description: Override the slot's opt-in status. true configures the slot without opting it into the default run (reach it with --all/--include); false forces it into the default run.

useConfig.description: Pick an adapter by name and override individual fields.

use.description: Adapter name to select from the registry.

description.description: User-facing text rendered beside this check in the CLI output. For maintainer commentary that should not render, use note.

changedArgs.description: Arguments appended under --changed. {base} in any of them expands to the base ref the run measures changes from (see changedBase).

optIn.description: Override the slot's opt-in status. true configures the slot without opting it into the default run (reach it with --all/--include); false forces it into the default run.

exclude.description: Links slot only: extra directory names to skip while walking for markdown, on top of the built-in exclude set (e.g. docs, research, .ridgeline).

allowlist.description: Links slot only: regex sources for link targets to treat as always valid (deliberately illustrative links that never resolve on disk).

profile.description: attw slot only: append --profile <name> (e.g. esm-only) to the attw invocation — a shortcut for retyping the full args.

exemplars.description: prose slot only: repo-relative directory of hand-written voice exemplars. The check fails when the directory is missing or empty, and agent-setup adds an AGENTS.md stanza section telling writing sessions to read and imitate the exemplars (never edit them).

order.description: Scheduling order. A number places the check on the ascending wave line (equal numbers run together as one wave; decimals sequence steps within a wave); the keywords place it relative to that line — first/last before/after everything, single exclusively on its own, middle/any unordered in the main group.

customCheck.description: A bare command that needs no adapter.

description.description: User-facing text rendered beside this check in the CLI output. For maintainer commentary that should not render, use note.

changedArgs.description: Arguments appended under --changed. {base} in any of them expands to the base ref the run measures changes from (see changedBase).

detect.description: Marker files that gate a non-catalogue custom check: it runs only when at least one listed file exists, and is skipped otherwise. Ignored on an entry that fills a catalogue slot.

optIn.description: true holds this custom check out of the default run — it runs only under --all/--include <name>. Absent runs it by default.

skipExitCode.description: The exit code that means "could not run here". A check that exits with it records as skipped (not failed), with its last stderr line as the reason, and is left out of checks_run; fix reports it as skipped too. Pick a code the check never uses for a real failure; 77 is the usual one.
